annotations.text:
Two buyer-facing surfaces, one platform:

TOP ROW — the marketplace (www.{platform}.com): platform brand, discovery across all shops.

BOTTOM ROW — the standalone shop website ({slug}.{platform}.com or the shop's own domain, e.g. arunima.com.bd): the vendor's brand fills the frame; the platform is one footer line.

Same products power both.

v1 ordering: no cart, no checkout. The primary CTA opens WhatsApp with the order pre-filled (product, size, colour, price, ref code). Messenger can't pre-fill a message, so the ref code is shown on the page with a copy button.

Stock shows as availability bands (In stock / Only a few left), never exact counts — seller-maintained stock drifts, and a band doesn't lie.

Shop PROFILE ≠ shop WEBSITE. This page lives inside marketplace chrome (marketplace search, bottom nav). The vendor's banner sits within it, and the "Website" button leads to their standalone site (bottom row).

Trust signals in v1 are only what we can verify: verified badge, followers, joined date, order-request counts. Star ratings & reviews arrive with v2 checkout.

Chosen direction — "Warm curated" (page 1): editorial warmth with commerce density in the middle. Plum + marigold + cream; Bricolage Grotesque + Instrument Sans; WhatsApp green reserved for the one action that matters.

These two sketches are genuinely different stances, not shades of the same idea. Say the word and page 1 pivots.
